gen-gf-turret-road-fs-ranade: Bent-glass roundness: Turret Road makes its letters look like tubing curved into open parentheses, while Ranade stays thin and tall. Ranade's spread-out line lets paragraphs drift along unhurried.
gen-gf-turret-road-fs-supreme: Commanding in Turret Road, whose round forms curve like open parentheses, with Supreme taking a heavier, crisper tone below. Supreme holds its letters open instead of curling them shut, so paragraphs move along without snagging.
gen-gf-turret-road-general-sans: Turret Road draws bold, parenthesis-round letters with a pen-like line of constant weight. General Sans follows with a tall x-height and smooth curves, a sans-serif partner that fills the line.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-orbit: Bold, rounded Turret Road takes the top with a pen-like line of constant weight. And Orbit's characters float apart, curves stopping short of closing, so a sans-serif paragraph moves along lightly.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-science-gothic: Science Gothic reads one letter at a time, its stroke ends set far apart. Turret Road adds bold, parenthesis-round forms on top, a commanding display line over sans text whose strokes never swell or thin.
gen-gf-turret-road-gf-syncopate: Turret Road is bold and round, like a row of open parentheses. Syncopate, a sans-serif, runs with technical-pen steadiness and rope-ladder spacing, so a long stretch of it feels measured and patient.
gen-gf-turret-road-manrope: Big round parentheses up top: that's Turret Road, drawn with a pen-like line of constant weight. Manrope then opens a bright gap at every curve's mouth, so a paragraph of this sans reads clean and approachable.
gen-gf-turret-road-montserrat: Montserrat glides under the eye like wire, geometric and friendly. What stands out most is openness: Turret Road's round, bold forms meet roomy white space and oversized counters in the body.
gen-gf-turret-road-satoshi: Satoshi soars with a tall x-height and a wide-open e that never looks squeezed shut. Turret Road brings the bold, commanding punch, while Satoshi handles the quiet work of every line below.
gen-gf-turret-road-switzer: Round forms like open parentheses define Turret Road, bold and commanding, drawn in a pen-like line of constant weight. Shrink the heading and Switzer's tall, wire-like letters take over.
